metadata.description: Delegate scoped, bounded tasks to OpenAI Codex agents via tmux sessions. Hard fork of Bootoshi/codex-orchestrator with an enforced invocation contract.

plugins.description: Orchestrate OpenAI Codex agents from Claude Code. Spawns parallel agents under an invocation contract that refuses unscoped reviews, bounds every run with a timeout, and reports non-convergence instead of burning hours silently.
plugins.name: codex-agent
